record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Shushaneduth<WH07802>, Michtam<WH04387> of David<WH01732>, to teach<WH03925><WTH8763>; when he strove<WH05327><WTH8687> with Aramnaharaim<WH0763><WH05104> and with Aramzobah<WH0760>, when Joab<WH03097> returned<WH07725><WTH8799>, and smote<WH05221><WTH8686> of Edom<WH0123> in the valley<WH01516> of salt<WH04417> twelve<WH08147><WH06240> thousand<WH0505>.<Fo><Fo> O God<WH0430>, thou hast cast us off<WH02186><WTH8804>, thou hast scattered<WH06555><WTH8804> us, thou hast been displeased<WH0599><WTH8804>; O turn thyself to us again<WH07725><WTH8787>. <RF>Michtam: or, A golden Psalm<Rf> <RF>scattered: Heb. broken<Rf>
Thou hast made the earth<WH0776> to tremble<WH07493><WTH8689>; thou hast broken<WH06480><WTH8804> it: heal<WH07495><WTH8798> the breaches<WH07667> thereof; for it shaketh<WH04131><WTH8804>.
Thou hast shewed<WH07200><WTH8689> thy people<WH05971> hard things<WH07186>: thou hast made us to drink<WH08248><WTH8689> the wine<WH03196> of astonishment<WH08653>.
Thou hast given<WH05414><WTH8804> a banner<WH05251> to them that fear<WH03373> thee, that it may be displayed<WH05127><WTH8710> because<WH06440> of the truth<WH07189>. Selah<WH05542>.
That thy beloved<WH03039> may be delivered<WH02502><WTH8735>; save<WH03467><WTH8685> <FI>with<Fi> thy right hand<WH03225>, and hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me.<CM>

God<WH0430> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> in his holiness<WH06944>; I will rejoice<WH05937><WTH8799>, I will divide<WH02505><WTH8762> Shechem<WH07927>, and mete out<WH04058><WTH8762> the valley<WH06010> of Succoth<WH05523>.

Gilead<WH01568> <FI>is<Fi> mine, and Manasseh<WH04519> <FI>is<Fi> mine; Ephraim<WH0669> also <FI>is<Fi> the strength<WH04581> of mine head<WH07218>; Judah<WH03063> <FI>is<Fi> my lawgiver<WH02710><WTH8781>;

Moab<WH04124> <FI>is<Fi> my washpot<WH05518><WH07366>; over Edom<WH0123> will I cast out<WH07993><WTH8686> my shoe<WH05275>: Philistia<WH06429>, triumph<WH07321><WTH8708> thou because of me. <RF>triumph...: or, triumph thou over me: (by an irony)<Rf>
Who will bring<WH02986><WTH8686> me <FI>into<Fi> the strong<WH04692> city<WH05892>? who will lead<WH05148><WTH8804> me into Edom<WH0123>? <RF>strong...: Heb. city of strength?<Rf>
<FI> Wilt<Fi> not thou, O God<WH0430>, <FI>which<Fi> hadst cast us off<WH02186><WTH8804>? and <FI>thou<Fi> , O God<WH0430>, <FI>which<Fi> didst not go out<WH03318><WTH8799> with our armies<WH06635>?
Give<WH03051><WTH8798> us help<WH05833> from trouble<WH06862>: for vain<WH07723> <FI>is<Fi> the help<WH08668> of man<WH0120>. <RF>help of man: Heb. salvation, etc<Rf>
Through God<WH0430> we shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> valiantly<WH02428>: for he <FI>it is that<Fi> shall tread down<WH0947><WTH8799> our enemies<WH06862>.<CM>
